notes: National rules; no region is needed.

items.name: Annual Accounts Prepared by the Board
items.rule: Within 5 months after financial year end (the shareholders may extend this by up to 5 months)
items.description: The shareholders adopt the accounts within 2 months after they are prepared.

items.name: Annual Accounts Filed with the Chamber of Commerce
items.rule: Within 8 days of adoption and no later than 12 months after financial year end
items.applies: BV and NV; branches file the foreign company's accounts
items.description: Micro and small companies file digitally through SBR; late filing can make directors personally liable in a bankruptcy.

items.name: Business Register Changes
items.rule: Within 1 week of the change (new address, officers, activities or trade names)
items.applies: Every business registered with the Chamber of Commerce
items.description: Changes are reported online to the KVK.

items.name: UBO Register
items.description: Ultimate beneficial owners are registered with the Chamber of Commerce.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return (vennootschapsbelasting)
items.rule: Within 5 months after financial year end (before 1 June for a calendar year); later under a tax adviser's extension scheme
items.description: Filed digitally; a provisional assessment is paid during the year.

items.name: Dividend Withholding Tax Return
items.rule: Within 1 month after the dividend is made payable
items.description: The return and the tax withheld are due together.

items.name: Income Tax Return
items.description: Business profit is reported in the owner's income tax return.

items.name: VAT Return (quarterly)
items.rule: Last day of the month after each quarter
items.description: Filed and paid by the same date.

items.name: VAT Return (monthly)
items.rule: Last day of the following month
items.description: Filed and paid by the same date.

items.name: VAT Return (annual)
items.applies: Small VAT-registered businesses allowed to file once a year
items.description: Filed and paid by the same date.

items.name: Leaving the Small Businesses Scheme (KOR)
items.rule: As soon as turnover passes €20,000 in a calendar year
items.applies: Businesses using the VAT exemption for small businesses
items.description: VAT is charged from the supply that passes the limit and returns begin.

items.name: Payroll Tax Return (loonheffingen)
items.rule: Within 1 month after each monthly period
items.description: Wage tax, national insurance and employee insurance contributions are filed and paid together.

items.name: Work-Related Costs Scheme — Final Levy
items.rule: With the return for the second payroll period of the next year (by 31 March)
items.applies: Employers that exceeded the tax-free allowance
items.description: An 80% final levy on the excess.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Documentation
items.rule: Available when the corporate income tax return is filed
items.applies: Companies with related-party transactions (master file and local file for groups with €50 million turnover or more)
items.description: Country-by-country notifications are due by the end of the group's financial year.
